method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Scientific calculator on the home page
x², x³, xʸ, eˣ, 10ˣ
features.verse_evidence: x² and xʸ present; no x³, eˣ, 10ˣ keys (typing ^ works)

features.name: √, ∛, ʸ√x
features.verse_evidence: √ and ∛ present; no y-th root key

features.name: ln, log, n!, 1/x, %, ±, EXP, π, e
features.verse_evidence: keys ln log n! 1/x % ± EXP π e

features.name: Financial calculators
features.detail: mortgage, loan, auto loan, interest, compound interest, payment, retirement, amortization, investment, inflation, income tax, salary, sales tax
features.verse_evidence: loan/mortgage and tip answered on the stage (skills/loan.js, skills/tip.js); none linked from /calculator/

features.name: Fitness and health calculators
features.detail: BMI, calorie, body fat, BMR, ideal weight, pace, pregnancy, due date
features.verse_evidence: no health calculators found in skills/

features.name: Math calculators
features.detail: fraction, percentage, random number, triangle, standard deviation, statistics
features.verse_evidence: percent works in the sum ("17% of 240"); random on /random/; no fraction, triangle or statistics calculators

features.name: Other calculators
features.detail: age, date, time, hours, GPA, grade, concrete, subnet, conversion
features.verse_evidence: date maths on the stage (skills/date-calc.js); unit conversion on /calculator/ and /convert/; no GPA, concrete or subnet

features.name: Search across 200+ calculators
features.detail: a search box to find a calculator by name
features.verse_evidence: asking Verse anything routes to a skill; no calculator index on /calculator/

features.name: Explanations and formulas on each calculator page
features.detail: each calculator explains the maths with worked text
features.verse_evidence: the page explains percent and precision; no per-formula articles
